title: Gilbert in his old age told some cavaliers he got a pass for nowt from Maister Gatherer one time mass he did and he seen his brud Maister Wull the playwriter up in Lunnon in a wrastling play wud a man on’s back.
html_source: The “wrestling play” to which Gilbert refers is presumably As You Like It which features a wrestling scene between Orlando and Charles. William Shakespeare himself would have been playing Orlando.
